name: Light Sleeper (General)
body:
You have learned to sleep lightly, leaving you able to detect the slightest disturbances.

Prerequisite(s): Perception 5 ranks

Benefit(s): You may roll twice when making Perception checks to wake up and take the better result.

Blood & Steel, Book 1: The Fighter. Copyright 2014, d20pfsrd.com Publishing; Author: Taylor Hubler.
